boundaries.http_e2e: Client HTTP request through authentication, routing, agents and telemetry; login excluded
boundaries.request_total_ms: Handler wall time before persistence of the agent event; authentication excluded
boundaries.stages: Wall times; null means skipped. Nested stages overlap; parallel agent durations must not be added to infer E2E
boundaries.first_pass: First pass after restart; models preloaded. Only the first relevant request is first inference, not all ten
boundaries.warm_pass: Same questions and order; includes the existing query-translation cache

limitations: Timing smoke, not a quality or load benchmark. No OCR/upload work occurs during chat. Provider/network variance and translation caching affect results. Resource peaks are sampled container-wide, not attributed to E5.

startup.note: Includes Compose recreation and startup model loading; cached weights; no question or inference warm-up

background_traffic.note: Other requests were observed during the first pass; benchmark concurrency is one but the shared server was not isolated.

measurement_notes: Per-stage medians include executed stages from the citation-rejected request; its timings were recovered from the unique failed server event between two matching response events.
Null stages are excluded from stage distributions, never converted to zero.
Nested totals and concurrent agent durations overlap. Generation is the sum of calls within a request; it can overlap retrieval in the other branch.
Warm-pass query translation used the existing in-process cache. No generated-answer cache was added.
No model quality evaluation, OCR rerun, isolated-server load test or production p95 claim. No Vercel frontend was deployed.
